title: RWB-S8-E7008-APP: no source defines the override as a record of S8 or gives the forum's reason a field, no rule row names the review forum and no operation reads the deviation list, the plan's C row is empty while the package read is consumed and the S8 matrix row carries no P7 edge, the primary role holds R only while the review needs U, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-08
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7008-APP; context pack S8 rwb-deviation (service row, ownership rows: table deviation, 2 REST operations, EV-06 and EV-07, workflow DeviationWorkflow, no job; Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13; Temporal and Drools slides 5, 8 and 13); legacy RWB-E7-008; FSD S8 Deviation handling v4 A1.2, A1.3, A2.17, A2.17.2, A2.17.3.1, A2.17.3.2, A2.17.3.3 and A2.17.4; TSD S8 Deviation handling v3 T0.2, T0.4, T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules and States sheets; Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-06 and EV-07; API Specification v4 components Deviation and DeviationOutcome; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DVF-08
description: (1) The legacy story says the feature puts overrides in front of the review forum, but no source defines an override entity: TSD S8 T3.1 gives S8 one table, deviation, with DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045, and the FSD S8 A2.17.3.2 field catalog lists the same deviation fields only, so the reviewed record is read as the open deviation at DEV_WITH_OWNER (ASM-B2-S8-008-1). (2) The legacy text asks for the reason of each override and no field carries it: the FSD names no reason field, deviation has no reason column, and the only published request element of API-S8-002 is DeviationOutcome with outcome and note (ASM-B2-S8-008-2). (3) No rule row of the 22-row DEVIATION set names a review forum or an override: R-DEV-09, R-DEV-10 and R-DEV-22 fire on DEVIATION_RESOLVED and R-DEV-11 reaches CASE_ENDED on INSURANCE_SETTLED, so the forum's act is the outcome that is recorded and the row that fires on it (ASM-B2-S8-008-1, ASM-B2-S8-008-4). (4) The context pack gives this service two REST operations and no read of the deviation list, while the legacy screen table gives SCR-08 the state Loading; list, so the list the screen shows has no published operation (ASM-B2-S8-008-5). (5) The plan's C row for this story is None, yet the review cannot run without the DEVIATION package at its version in force, and the S8 row of the connection matrix carries no P7 edge although the R3 default ruling gives the rule package registry to rwb-decision (ASM-B2-S8-008-3). (6) FSD S8 A2.17.3.3 names the Risk and model risk officer as primary, TSD S8 T6.1 gives RW-RISK R on the case record, and TSD S8 T-A.1 declares right U on both operations, so the primary role cannot record a review without a right the matrix does not give it (ASM-B2-S8-008-6). (7) TSD S8 T8 maps every REQ-DVH and REQ-S8 row to FEAT-DVH-01, FEAT-DVF-01 or 'Written one epic ahead', and the legacy story carries no REQ id, so the story cites no requirement (ASM-B2-S8-008-9).
evidence: TSD S8 T3.1 (ten columns, no reason, no override); FSD S8 A2.17.3.2 (eight fields); API Specification v4 DeviationOutcome (outcome enum RETURNED, RE_ROUTED, CASE_ENDED and note string); TSD S8 T4 and Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-09, R-DEV-10, R-DEV-11 and R-DEV-22; context pack ownership rows (2 REST operations, no job) and connection matrix row S8 (no P7 cell); TSD S8 T6.1 row RW-RISK R and T-A.1 access Case record U; TSD S8 T8
owner_role: Business lead; solution architect; rwb-decision rule owner; rwb-access owner
proposed: Read the override as the open deviation record of the case, record the forum's outcome and its reason through DeviationOutcome (outcome over LOV-DEV-OUTCOME, the reason on note) into the local decision record and deviation.outcome, move the deviation on R-DEV-09, R-DEV-10 and R-DEV-22 only, leave cleared_at, the contact stop, the clock resume and the route reopen to FEAT-DVH-06 and the route stories, read the package on a class C row with a fake, keep the case and the clock with rwb-case, and hold the requirement row and the list read as open items.

title: RWB-S8-E7008-CON: the DeviationOutcome element carries no reason property and no source publishes its name, field ID or value format, no operation reads the deviation list, the plan's C row is empty while the baseline declares one consumed row and DP-04, DP-05, DP-07, DP-08 and DP-09 are absent, the primary role holds R only, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-08
source: Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S8-E7008-CON; context pack S8 rwb-deviation (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 5, 8 and 13); legacy RWB-E7-008; FSD S8 Deviation handling v4 A2.17.2, A2.17.3.1, A2.17.3.2, A2.17.3.3 and A2.17.4.4; TSD S8 Deviation handling v3 T0.1, T0.2, T0.3, T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DEV-09, R-DEV-10, R-DEV-11 and R-DEV-22; Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-06 and EV-07; API Specification v4 components Deviation, DeviationRequest and DeviationOutcome; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DVF-08
description: (1) TSD S8 T-A.2 publishes the request and answer element names, the right and the error status codes 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503, and the API Specification v4 publishes Deviation with ten properties and DeviationOutcome with outcome and note; no source publishes a reason property, a reason field ID or a reason value format, so the forum's reason is declared on note with a placeholder (ASM-B2-S8-008-2). (2) The override is declared as the open deviation record: no source gives S8 a second table, an override path or an override property set (ASM-B2-S8-008-1). (3) No source publishes a deviation-list read, and the context pack gives the service two operations only, so the list state of SCR-08 has no operation to declare (ASM-B2-S8-008-5). (4) The plan's C row is None while the baseline declares the DEVIATION package read of rwb-decision as consumed, and the S8 row of the connection matrix carries no P7 edge; DP-04, DP-05, DP-07, DP-08 and DP-09 are real dependencies of the step that the plan's pattern set does not hold (ASM-B2-S8-008-3, ASM-B2-S8-008-5). (5) TSD S8 T6.1 gives RW-RISK, RW-CONDUCT and RW-COE R on the case record while both operations declare right U, and the baseline records the conflict rather than widening the matrix (ASM-B2-S8-008-6, ASM-B2-S8-008-7). (6) No requirement row traces to FEAT-DVF-08 in TSD S8 T8 or in the legacy story, so the baseline carries no requirement (ASM-B2-S8-008-9).
evidence: API Specification v4 DeviationOutcome (outcome enum and note string, no reason) and Deviation (ten properties); TSD S8 T-A.1 and T-A.2; TSD S8 T3.1 and T3.2 (three lists, none for a reason); FSD S8 A2.17.3.2; context pack ownership rows (2 REST operations) and connection matrix row S8 (no P7 cell); split plan slice RWB-S8-E7008-CON (C empty); TSD S8 T6.1; TSD S8 T8
owner_role: Solution architect; rwb-deviation tech lead; business lead; rwb-decision rule owner; rwb-access owner
proposed: Publish the review branch inside API-S8-002 with the published DeviationOutcome (outcome over LOV-DEV-OUTCOME and note carrying the reason with a placeholder), declare the package read as a class C row with a fake and no rule row, declare no override entity, no list read, no event, no Schedule and no cleared_at property, fix the twelve holders of right U and the three read-only review roles as a recorded conflict, and hold the requirement row open.
